$comment: Reminders staff and leaders set for themselves (issue 22, decisions D-reminders-1 to D-reminders-4). Rock's two shipped reminder types hold them: a Personal Reminder points at the person's primary alias, and a Group Reminder at the group. Every date counts from the install day, so each Cast reminder is due, upcoming, or complete on any install day. Each owner's ReminderCount is what Rock's Process Reminders job would set: their reminders that are due and not complete.
$castComment: The Cast's own reminders. owner is the person who set it. A Personal Reminder names the person it is about, and a Group Reminder names the group. set is when it was set. date is when it is due: daysAgo, daysAhead, or beforeNextBaptismSunday (that many days before the next Easter or July baptism Sunday, and never before tomorrow). A repeating reminder repeats everyDays after each time it is completed, as Rock repeats one, and completed says how many times it has been. expect is what Rock shows on any install day: due, upcoming, or complete.

cast.note: Rent is due on the first. Check in with Ashley and ask how she and the kids are doing.
Ask Josh to share his story at the next baptism Sunday.
Pick a night for the group's end-of-season party and send a sign-up for food.

$generatedComment: Reminders for generated people and groups. A staff member sets a reminder about some of the generated people they wrote a note on, the day they wrote it, more often for follow-up and care notes. A generated small group's leader sets group reminders for some active groups. A reminder falls daysAfter its setting. A past one is complete, except that duePercent of those due in the last dueWithinDays are still due. A few repeat, completed each time a few days after it comes due.
$notesComment: The note on each generated reminder. {name} is the person's nickname or first name.
